high_level_description: The image shows the screen of an iPhone displaying the "All Recordings" section of the Voice Memos app. The time at the top indicates it is 2:31 PM, with LTE connectivity and a battery icon showing that the phone is charging. Below the title, there is a search bar labeled "Titles, Transcripts," which allows users to search through their recordings by title or transcript.
